exe_findings.actor_table_context: SAM1 special-low map token table around 0x3A59/0x267C3 initializes these raw bytes as actor-backed cells, not static collision sprites.
exe_findings.actor_record: The active sprite/object id is stored in DS:34E0 + slot*0x20; direction in DS:34E2, frame counter in DS:34D6, timer in DS:34DA, period in DS:34D8.
exe_findings.rip_visual_id: 0x027E is the RIP/grave runtime visual id; the actor transition code writes it to runtime cell +0x1CA and clears +0x1CC.
exe_findings.shot_rip_score: The branch comparing AX with 0x027B removes the object, calls the score popup helper, and adds 0x01F4 (500) to DS:699A/699C.
exe_findings.pickup_rip_score: The branch comparing AX with 0x027E can add 0x61A8 (25000) to DS:699A/699C under its game-state conditions.
exe_findings.user_observed_damage_chain: Bank 14 groups begin at tiles 0, 8, 16, 24, 32.  Projectile hits degrade to the lower group; tile 0 hit becomes tile 40 RIP.
